actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. _Hit:_ 14 (2d8+5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Stomp

actions.desc: The elephant grabs one Large or smaller creature within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 15 STR save or be grappled (escape DC 15). The elephant can grapple only one creature at a time.
actions.desc_ru: Действие «Трунк Граб»; тип: bonus_action. Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
actions.name: Trunk Grab

traits.desc: If the elephant moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 15 STR save or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the elephant can make one Stomp attack against it as a bonus action.
